title: When a surprise unsettles expectations

captions.energy: Trying care without a ready rulebook

meaning: Your care can keep its warmth after an unsuccessful surprise when the shaken expectation can be named specifically.
text: Unexpected tenderness may reach a very different feeling from the one you anticipated. In the physical position of Anahata, the Empress expresses attention concretely through preparing food, decorating or arranging comfort. The Fool in energy brings a wish to try care beyond the usual rules and trust a new idea. The Tower in emotions shows the sharpness of the experience when an assumption about welcome involvement collapses. A mistake can feel particularly unsettling because the intention was warm. Closeness then needs room for both the effort and the actual response to it.

For example, you unexpectedly rearrange the furniture to make a comfortable corner for two. The person returning finds pleasure difficult because the familiar arrangement mattered. **An unsuccessful surprise can begin a conversation about what really cares for you both.** You can put some things back and choose one change together. Involvement survives a mistake when it hears the consequences and stops insisting on the original beautiful picture.

The difficulty is defending freedom of intention against every response. You claim that otherwise surprising each other is impossible, making novelty an excuse for inattention. Alternatively, being shaken by the answer forbids every new gesture. Care can remain alive between these extremes: each idea need not work, and one particular mistake does not define your entire way of being tender.
